title: Continuity Node: Reference Implementation of the Continuity Node Framework
description: A runnable Python reference implementation of the Continuity Node Framework, demonstrating a user-owned, local-first longitudinal memory-and-interpretation architecture with raw/interpretation separation, rebuildable derived state, provenance-tagged interpretive lineage, governed pattern promotion and demotion, and interchangeable inference-engine boundaries. This software implements a bounded Tier-1 subset of the broader framework and should not be read as a complete implementation of the defensive publication.
references: Walker, Joseph JM. "System and Method for User-Owned Longitudinal Memory and Interpretation System with a Provenance-Tagged Interpretive Ledger, Engine-Interchangeable Inference, Federated Validation, and Generational Maintenance." Technical Disclosure Commons, June 7, 2026. https://www.tdcommons.org/dpubs_series/10374/
